title: Resolution to rename city streets for the champion Knicks
summary: This resolution calls for ten famed New York City locations to be ceremonially renamed for one year to honor the 2026 NBA champion New York Knicks. Examples include Fifth Avenue as "Knicks in 5 Avenue," Broadway as "Brunsonway," Times Square as "Towns Square" and the Bronx River as "Breen River." The renamings honor players, the coach and the team's longtime broadcaster.
